class: Any playbook rule (T-01, T-03, T-07, T-09, T-11, T-13 and every other F-71 crossing rule) on any tracked strategy, live or test data, whose FIRST background check, or a screen check made before that first check, happens after the rule has already crossed: the rule is stored and shown as 'Already true when tracking started' and never flags until it clears, although it was false at the real entry.
mechanism: The entry baseline is not stored at entry. Three callers each choose one at check time: the worker's write (background.py:1207 record_check with scn=None, then adjustment_check.py:535-536 'elif not memory: entry = state') and the worker's own check (background.py:1187 'None if known else state') take the CURRENT state as the entry; the screen uses the fixture entry in test mode and the current state otherwise. held_at_entry is fixed at first insert (playbook_store.py:250-252, migration 0031 trigger), so a baseline taken after a crossing is permanent.

first_seen.where: IC test-data run on the scenario copy (code 514113f1), scratch ISSUES.md issue 65 (PATH-12, PATH-14) and 89 (PATH-15), condor 112 (PATH-13)
first_seen.evidence: SELECT rule_id, held_at_entry, seen_clear FROM public.adjustment_rule_state WHERE strategy_id = 115 (7 Nov 00:4x): T-01, T-03, T-13 held_at_entry=true, seen_clear=false, the three rules the screen showed 'already true' at the 0.87 % gap frame although at the Thursday entry (spot 23,100) none held; condor 113, whose first background check ran at frame 0, flagged T-11 correctly. Independent read-only review 7 Nov 00:1x-00:3x (fresh Opus) traced the three baselines; lines re-read by the lead.

fix: none yet (development on hold). Proposed by the review: store the entry baseline once when tracking starts (first fill, next to entry_facts_store, ADR-243), one function for all three callers, delete the 'entry = current state' fallbacks, ADR-258 writes its new baseline through the same function, one-off repair of rows written after a crossing.

detection.note: F-71 tests pass a fixed entry to evaluate(); test_background_cycle uses a fake recorder; no test makes a first check after a crossing or compares screen and worker on one path. Needed: those three tests.

live_example: A condor filled at 15:27 is first checked at 09:16 the next morning after a 0.9 % gap up: T-13 is stored held_at_entry=true and the gap warning never fires.
